mapper.select: select f.id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.create_time, null as target_title, null as target_cover_image, null as target_summary from voya_ai_favorite f left join voya_ai_city c on f.target_type = 'city' and f.target_id = c.id and c.del_flag = '0' left join voya_ai_attraction a on f.target_type = 'attraction' and f.target_id = a.id and a.del_flag = '0' left join voya_ai_guide g on f.target_type = 'guide' and f.target_id = g.id and g.del_flag = '0' where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.target_type = #{targetType} and f.target_id = #{targetId} and (f.target_type = 'trip' or c.id is not null or a.id is not null or g.id is not null)
select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time from voya_ai_favorite where id = #{id}
select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time from voya_ai_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} for update
select count(*) from voya_ai_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: insert into voya_ai_favorite (user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from voya_ai_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select f.id, f.user_id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, case f.target_type when 'city' then c.name when 'attraction' then a.name when 'guide' then g.title when 'trip' then null end as target_title, case f.target_type when 'city' then c.cover_image when 'attraction' then a.cover_image when 'guide' then g.cover_image when 'trip' then null end as target_cover_image, case f.target_type when 'guide' then g.summary else null end as target_summary from voya_ai_favorite f left join voya_ai_user u on f.user_id = u.id left join voya_ai_city c on f.target_type = 'city' and f.target_id = c.id left join voya_ai_attraction a on f.target_type = 'attraction' and f.target_id = a.id left join voya_ai_guide g on f.target_type = 'guide' and f.target_id = g.id where f.id = #{id}
